summary: 9 m kerb of a triangular island at a junction; too short, homes close.

drivers.seclusion: Dense houses; a detached home 12 m away and more within 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 9 m of kerb on a junction island edge; a van would overhang the junction.
drivers.convention: No signs; a couple of cars parked just past the island.

sun_shade: Open on the island; tree shade from the west.
